dialogues.speaker: Railah
dialogues.text: Every result has a reason, and every reason has a consequence.

dialogues.speaker: Railah
dialogues.text: Was it too difficult to understand?

dialogues.speaker: Railah
dialogues.text: Ah, it's fine. That's what everyone thinks. You're not the first, and definitely not the last.

dialogues.speaker: Railah
dialogues.text: It's just like my research. It doesn't matter if I think forward or go backward, the possibilities are always infinite.

dialogues.speaker: Railah
dialogues.text: Goodbye. Farewells and reunions are mutually fulfilling as well.

dialogues.speaker: Railah
dialogues.text: Knowledge does not change with locale, and locale does not change with knowledge.

dialogues.speaker: Railah
dialogues.text: Rainforest and desert, permit and prohibition, wisdom and ignorance, life and death... Everything in the world is just like that.

dialogues.speaker: Railah
dialogues.text: As the cause, so the effect. Would you like to try again?

dialogues.speaker: Railah
dialogues.text: What? ...I lost? Hmm, but what is there to complain about, anyway...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds reasonable but doesn't quite make sense in the meantime.

dialogues.speaker: Railah
dialogues.text: Hahaha, that means you have reached the threshold of wisdom.

dialogues.speaker: Railah
dialogues.text: Good, good. You are clever, even better than many scholars.
